versions.notes:
### ✨ Improved

- **Changes** in the Status column now opens and closes the list of changed files with the same click, instead of refreshing it.
- **Tasks** now lists only the agents and Gentle tasks working for you. Shell commands no longer show up there.

### 🐛 Fixed

- The sessions show/hide icon above the chat is gone in the Agent layout, where sessions already have their own column.
- Closing the Status column while it was still loading no longer leaves stray errors in the console.
- Gentle's memory engine pin moves to 0.6.0.

### 🧠 Memory

- Updating the memory engine now takes effect: after it downloads, PiCode offers **Restart engine** (and does it for you with **Update all**), so the new version runs without closing every window.
- A version that is already downloaded is no longer offered again; the panel tells you a restart is all that's missing.
- The update dialog shows a single **Cancel** button.

### ✨ Chat

- **Undo these changes** under a change card now asks first, turns grey once used, and says so if the changes were already undone. It is drawn as a quiet action with an icon instead of a solid blue button.

### 🐛 Fixed

- chat, Status and memory polish, pasted images reach pi; release v1.0.4-experimental (#151)

### ✨ New

- **A cleaner Agent layout.** The chat no longer has a "Chat / Ports" row above it, the sessions column reaches the bottom of the window, and the "Pi" picker under the message box is gone.
- **Thinking level as a dropdown.** Pick how hard the AI thinks from a small list under its button, like the model picker.
- **Reasoning and command cards, tidied.** The AI's reasoning reads calmer, and an opened command card now shows the command that ran and what it printed.
- **White logos on dark themes.** GitHub and similar dark logos are readable again.

### 🐛 Fixed

- The command box of a finished tool call no longer comes up empty.
- On the MCP servers page, "Needs sign-in" no longer hides behind the sign-in button.

### ✨ New

- **Show What's New in the Help menu.** Open the window with what changed whenever you want. If this version has no notes of its own, it shows the latest ones.

### 🐛 Fixed

- After an update, PiCode no longer sends you to the repository's release list in your browser; you only see its own What's New window.

### ✨ New

- **Try the Agent layout from What's New.** If you are still on the Editor layout, the window that shows what changed now has a button to switch to Agent.
- **Easier code sign-in.** When signing in with a code, PiCode copies the code and opens the page for you.
- **Clearer cost.** In Status, a "~" before the cost means it is an estimate, not what your provider charged.
- **What's new in your packages.** After updating a package that lists its changes, a "What's new" button shows them.

### 🔧 Other changes

- The built-in AI agent (pi) is updated to 1.5.0: safer sign-ins, better stability on Windows and faster answers.

### ✨ New

- **Two ways of working: Agent or Editor.** Agent puts the chat in the middle, your sessions on the left and a review bar on the right; Editor is the VS Code you know. Switch any time, no restart.
- **A Status column** next to the chat: where the agent works, your MCP servers, the lines you changed (click to review every change), its tasks and what your memory holds.
- **13 languages.** The editor, the setup and everything PiCode adds are translated, and the setup opens in your computer's language and gets it ready for the editor.
- **A new setup:** pick your layout (Agent is marked by default), sign in or sign up from the account card, and the page keeps its place when you choose something.

### 🐛 Fixed

- The What's New history now reads in plain words for 0.8.0.

### ✨ New

- If you skip versions, What's New now shows what changed in each one you missed, not only the latest.

### 🐛 Fixed

- The What's New window no longer shows a stray line under the list.

### 🔧 Other changes

- Engram, the memory pi uses, is updated to 3.6.0.

### 🐛 Fixed

- What's New now also opens on the update that brings it in.
- Updating the portable version no longer opens empty command windows.

### ✨ New

- Voice dictation in the chat: talk and your words are typed phrase by phrase, all on your own computer.
- The microphone ring follows your voice, the text appears as you speak, and the message can send itself after a pause.
- Dictation can be set up from the first-run setup; it downloads with progress, is checked before use and can be cancelled.
- After an update, a window shows what changed.

### 🐛 Fixed

- The chat microphone shows up again, and dictation is no longer offered once it is installed.
